title: Residency Evidence Workflow Synthesizer and Hosted-API Pin Controls
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build an end-to-end workflow that synthesizes residency pin decisions, retention settings, and evidentiary artifacts for Hosted API endpoints into a machine-readable and human-ready package. Scope: - Residency pin controls UI + API for tenant-level and endpoint-level pinning. - Retention profile editor for Hosted endpoints with default and override policies. - Evidence synthesizer service that collates routing logs, retention settings, attestation metadata, and cryptographic hash manifests into a single evidence bundle (ZIP + JSON index). - Export API and scheduled evidence snapshots for legal/compliance and audit consumers. Success criteria: 1) Tenants can declare an endpoint region pin and see an automated compatibility check (latency/availability/backup-region). 2) Evidence bundles contain signed manifests and a deterministic index; bundles downloadable via UI and accessible via secure S3 link. 3) Scheduled export runs within configured windows, with retry/backoff and drift detection alerts. 4) Minimal manual steps for support to produce an audit-ready packet (< 10 minutes). Out of scope: on-prem private control plane export mechanics (addressed in Private plan). Acceptance criteria: - API endpoints for set/get pin and set/get retention profile with proper RBAC and audit log entries. - Evidence bundle schema documented and validated against sample exports. - Telemetry: per-tenant export success rate, export size distribution, average time-to-complete, and drift events. - Automated tests for common pin/retention permutations and end-to-end export flow. Key decisions to make: - Bundle signing approach: HSM-backed signature vs. server-side keypair. - Retention inheritance model: endpoint overrides tenant defaults or reverse? - UI wording for soft-failures when pinned region lacks capacity. Risks: - Incorrect evidence composition could fail audits. - Performance overhead of on-demand evidence assembly for large tenants. - Regulatory edge cases in multi-jurisdiction routing. Related artifacts: design draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RES/Residency+Evidence+Synthesis, proto API spec: https://gist.github.com/redwood-inference/aa12ef, sample bundle: https://storage.redwood.ai/samples/residency-bundle-sample.zip

notes: Rollout plan: start with a pilot for 10 tenants in hosted-us-west-2, enable evidence snapshots daily, collect feedback, then expand region-by-region. Fallback policy: when a pinned region is unhealthy, surface guided remediation and optionally allow enforced soft-fail to nearest compliant region.
engineering_guidance: Implement exporter as idempotent worker; use streaming zip composition to avoid high memory; include a manifest.json with schemaVersion and sha256 checksums for each file. Add feature-flag guarded rollout and per-tenant export rate limits.
